trips.title: Your trips
trips.subtitle: Plan locally, then share the plan with someone you trust.

trips.form.notesPlaceholder: Route notes, meeting point, transport, known hazards…

trips.group.empty.title: Nothing in this group
trips.group.empty.body: Trips will appear here when their dates or status match this filter.
trips.form.errorSummary: Fix the highlighted fields to continue.
trips.detail.readinessEmpty: No readiness answers yet. Answer the guidance questions to prepare a plan.
trips.plan.checklistSummary: {done} of {total} items done · {requiredRemaining} required items remaining
trips.plan.guidanceEmpty: No guidance stored for this plan yet. Generate the plan to add recommendations.

trips.plan.noGuarantee: This plan helps you prepare. It is not a rescue guarantee, does not monitor you, and does not replace official emergency instructions.
